verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an official CLI, a single Go binary called `bolna`, that manages agents, calls, phone numbers and batches from the terminal, and a probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists. A versioning policy page indicates the CLI is still in beta. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, documented AI-native ergonomics such as machine-readable output or agent-friendly usage, and a stable non-beta release.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Bolna CLI (bolna) is a single Go binary that lets you manage agents, calls, phone numbers, and batches directly from your terminal
lets you manage agents, calls, phone numbers, and batches directly from your terminal — no dashboard tab required.
